contexts.text: The need of good for truth. Signified, Explained.
Truth has need of good, and good has need of truth; and when truth has need of good, truth is conjoined with good; and when good has need of truth, good is conjoined with truth.
As good increases, he is in need of truth.
In the Spiritual World... they (then) come again into need (of food).
What is meant by the need of spiritual things when truths were deficient.
They pass by those who need aid the most.
(The idea) that good is to be done to everyone who needs aid.
Not to have need of others, because all things are given him by the Lord. Signified.
They have governors, fewer or more according to the need of the Society.
That the beneficial things of charity are, to give to the poor, and aid the needy, but with prudence. General article.
